page.overview:
Who is Javil Fysh?

Javil Fysh was a merchant and the associate and partner of Petru Cobbin. He met the witcher Geralt and the dwarf Addario Bach when the duo where asked to escort the cutter, the Prophet Lebioda, on its voyage. The vessel was hunted by an Aguara as it was holding its offspring, and whilst attempting to escape from the creature Javil was torn apart by a crocodile and a turtle.
